hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Transform each interval [start, end] into two discrete timestamp events: +1 at start and -1 after end.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Sort all boundary events chronologically, processing additions before removals if boundaries coincide.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Maintain a running counter of active overlapping members to find the peak concurrent team size.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def maxTeamSize(intervals: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    events = []
    for s, e in intervals:
        events.append((s, 1))
        events.append((e + 1, -1))
    events.sort()
    cur = 0
    max_team = 0
    for t, delta in events:
        cur += delta
        max_team = max(max_team, cur)
    return max_team
```

complexity.notes: Sorting 2n sweep-line boundary events takes O(n log n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all time units or pairwise overlaps takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard sweep-line point event counting.
